testcase.name: Scenario: Preview a measured extrusion extent in each direction: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/solid-model/extrusion/extrusion.feature:268:5
testcase.system-out: Scenario Outline: Preview a measured extrusion extent in each direction ✔> Given the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given a fresh copy of `fixtures/cad/revolve/revolve-profile.opd` is open in Extrude with its rectangle selected ✔ And the start reference is the sketch plane with both tapers zero ✔ When the user chooses Default and sets Distance A to 8 mm ✔ Then the extrusion preview extends 8 mm along the default direction ✔ And the command is ready to accept
